image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a decorative ceramic teacup resting on a matching saucer. The cup features a white base with intricate red and black floral/botanical patterns and a gold rim. A C-shaped handle is visible on the left side. The interior appears to be a solid reddish-brown color. A silver spoon rests on the right side of the saucer. The background is blurred (bokeh), showing hints of orange/red objects.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomy of the object as a 'cup' or 'teacup' and verify material properties.
To verify the structural integrity of the handle where it joins the cup body, a common failure point in AI generation.
To ensure the cup sits correctly on the saucer without floating or clipping artifacts.
To check if the floral pattern distorts or melts around the curvature of the cup.

focus_areas: Pattern consistency across the curved surface
Contact shadow between cup base and saucer
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the handle connection points. AI often fails to render the hole in the handle or fuses the handle to the body incorrectly. Also, verify that the floral pattern does not 'swim' or lose coherence near the rim and base edges.
